typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		bus_a_extl_key_c as string,
		lgle_id_c as integer,
		documentationLevel as string,
		lgle_n_c as string,
		bus_a_extl_n as string,
		system_c as string,
		bus_a_n as string,
		lgle_full_n as string,
		bus_a_id_c as integer,
		bus_a_extl_stat_c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> CDSPROD
CDSPROD derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		bus_a_extl_n as string,
		bus_a_id_c as string,
		lgle_id_c as string,
		lgle_full_n as string,
		bus_a_extl_stat_c as string,
		bus_a_extl_key_c as string,
		documentationLevel as string,
		system_c as string,
		bus_a_n as string,
		lgle_n_c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		bus_a_extl_n,
		bus_a_id_c,
		lgle_id_c,
		lgle_full_n,
		bus_a_extl_stat_c,
		bus_a_extl_key_c,
		documentationLevel,
		system_c,
		bus_a_n,
		lgle_n_c),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
